$comment: Pinned EmbeddingGemma-2-ONNX assets. Every sha256 here is real: LFS entries carry the repository tree API's `oid` (which is the file's sha256), and non-LFS files were downloaded from this exact revision and hashed locally. Each ONNX graph is paired with its `.onnx_data` external-weights file — the graph alone cannot load.

q8.label: q8 — shipped default (314 MB weights)
q8.note: 8-bit weights. Chosen as the default because integer kernels are what this host can run without AVX-512 VNNI; the whole quantisation spread measured within 17% of itself here.

q4f16.label: q4f16 — smallest (157 MB weights)
q4f16.note: 4-bit weights with float16 activations. Wants F16C and AVX2 to pay off; without them the half-precision values are converted on the fly.

fp16.label: fp16 — middle (542 MB weights)
fp16.note: Half precision throughout. Needs F16C and AVX; without them it is the slowest per byte on this host.

fp32.label: fp32 — largest (1.08 GB weights)
fp32.note: No special CPU features required, and the largest download by a wide margin. Listed for completeness rather than recommended.

files.$comment: Shared across variants. tokenizer.json is 32 MB rather than a few KB: EmbeddingGemma's vocabulary is 262k entries, and the tokenizer has to travel with the weights.
